items.summary: Recommendation: approve containment-only execution. Do not claim site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, or causal lift. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all commission in aggregate tracking ID `other`; site-attributed income is $0. September AI usage is $1,002.46 across 5,531 calls and 39 instrumented sites. These periods and attribution scopes do not support ROI. AI spend alone is not contribution margin; infrastructure, domains, labor, vendor, and other operating costs are absent. Keep new spend and new monetization work blocked. After capacity clears, the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement may proceed only as a measurement experiment against 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Do not treat clicks, impressions, sessions, ordered items, or proposals as financial outcomes.

Retain aggregate Amazon commission as explicitly unattributed. Require every new affiliate link to use its registered site tracking ID and preserve provider aggregate rows separately. Do not allocate the $4.92 aggregate commission to sites or infer revenue from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, or 6 shipped items. The minimum evidence for site contribution margin is period-aligned site revenue, shipped-item commission, AI cost, infrastructure/vendor cost, domain cost, and any directly attributable labor or production cost.

The queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement is financially acceptable only as a bounded, reportable experiment after capacity release. Preserve the 2026-09-21 baseline of 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission; require destination integrity and click measurement, with no revenue or ROI claim. Do not add spending, tracking, dependencies, credentials, or infrastructure commitments.
